name: Islautopia HTTPS for Home Assistant
description: Real HTTPS for your whole Home Assistant instance, with or without internet - no domain, no DNS account, no port forwarding. OPEN WEB UI below gives this device the certificate that keeps your local address trusted while the internet is down: once per device, and optional.

ports_description.8443/tcp: Secure HTTPS access to Home Assistant
ports_description.8099/tcp: Trust portal: downloads the certificate that keeps HTTPS working without internet (optional, plain HTTP by design)
